description: 1 表示标注员认为该概念是当前解释的相关理由；0 表示未选为理由，不表示棋盘上不存在此现象。不是引擎判断或因果证明。

concepts.name: 赢得子力
concepts.description: 通过这一选择，有机会净赢兵或其他棋子。
concepts.description_en: A choice that can win a pawn or piece after accounting for exchanges.

concepts.name: 避免丢子
concepts.description: 化解会造成净子力损失的威胁。
concepts.description_en: Prevent a threat that would lead to a net loss of material.

concepts.name: 有利交换
concepts.description: 交换后得到更合适的子力配置或局面。
concepts.description_en: Exchange pieces to obtain a more favorable arrangement or position.

concepts.name: 弃子与补偿
concepts.description: 牺牲子力以换取进攻、时间或位置收益。
concepts.description_en: Give up material for an attack, time or positional compensation.

concepts.name: 牵制
concepts.description: 一个棋子因身后更重要的目标而受到行动限制。
concepts.description_en: Restrict a piece because a more important target is behind it.

concepts.name: 双重攻击
concepts.description: 同时威胁两个或更多目标，使对手难以兼顾。
concepts.description_en: Threaten multiple targets so the opponent cannot easily cover them all.

concepts.name: 闪击／串击
concepts.description: 移动挡子暴露攻击，或迫使前方目标让出后方目标。
concepts.description_en: Uncover an attack or force a front target to expose one behind it.

concepts.name: 引离／防守过载
concepts.description: 移走关键防守子，或让它无法同时完成多个防守任务。
concepts.description_en: Divert a defender or make it unable to cover several duties.

concepts.name: 王的安全
concepts.description: 改善王的保护、逃生空间，或利用对方王的暴露。
concepts.description_en: Improve protection or escape squares, or exploit an exposed enemy king.

concepts.name: 将杀威胁
concepts.description: 建立或利用将杀威胁，让对手必须处理。
concepts.description_en: Create or use a checkmate threat that demands a response.

concepts.name: 化解直接威胁
concepts.description: 应对当前明确的将军、吃子或其他直接威胁。
concepts.description_en: Answer a concrete check, capture or other immediate threat.

concepts.name: 防守与反击资源
concepts.description: 用保护、阻挡、交换或反击维持局面。
concepts.description_en: Hold the position through protection, blocking, exchanges or counterplay.

concepts.name: 中心压力
concepts.description: 挑战中心据点，并使对手的布局或应对受到实际影响。
concepts.description_en: Challenge central strongpoints with consequences for the opponent’s plans.

concepts.name: 兵的突破
concepts.description: 通过兵的推进或交换改变兵形、打开进攻方向。
concepts.description_en: Use a pawn advance or exchange to change the structure or open play.

concepts.name: 通路兵
concepts.description: 创造、保留、推进或阻挡通路兵及其升变威胁。
concepts.description_en: Create, preserve, advance or block a passed pawn and its promotion threat.

concepts.name: 兵形弱点
concepts.description: 制造、攻击或修复孤兵、叠兵、落后兵等弱点。
concepts.description_en: Create, target or repair isolated, doubled, backward or other weak pawns.

concepts.name: 出子与协调
concepts.description: 让棋子进入有效位置，并相互配合完成任务。
concepts.description_en: Bring pieces into useful positions where they work together.

concepts.name: 活动性与空间
concepts.description: 增加有效可用的行动，或限制对方棋子的活动。
concepts.description_en: Increase useful options or restrict the opponent’s piece activity.

concepts.name: 线路的利用
concepts.description: 利用开放线或斜线产生具体压力，而非仅仅腾空格子。
concepts.description_en: Use a file or diagonal to exert concrete pressure, beyond just clearing it.

concepts.name: 关键格与据点
concepts.description: 占据、控制或争夺对计划有实际作用的重要格子。
concepts.description_en: Occupy or contest a square that contributes to a concrete plan.

concepts.name: 先手与走子顺序
concepts.description: 利用先手、节省步数，或通过顺序避免对手额外机会。
concepts.description_en: Use time or move order to avoid giving the opponent extra options.

concepts.name: 限制对方计划
concepts.description: 预先阻止对方尚未形成的计划或改善手段。
concepts.description_en: Preempt the opponent’s intended improvement or plan.

concepts.name: 开局布局与计划
concepts.description: 结合具体开局的兵形、出子顺序与典型后续计划。
concepts.description_en: Explain the opening structure, development order or typical continuation.

concepts.name: 残局与局面转换
concepts.description: 转入适合己方的残局、简化局面，或避免不利转换。
concepts.description_en: Reach a favorable endgame or transformation, or avoid an unfavorable one.

description_en: 1 means the annotator selected a concept as relevant to the explanation. 0 means not selected, not that the feature is absent. These are human labels, not causal proofs.
